name: Holding a request to a measure
vision_statement: A request becomes a metric with a target and a budget, adjustable while the work runs, and the result is held to it: was the goal met, and is the response good for this person.
opportunities: Translating a request into a metric, creating and editing the specs and metrics, judging goal completion and judging response quality are four ML tasks, each improvable on its own accuracy.
solution_coherence: Critical Thinking holds a request to a measure. Metric Translation turns the request into a metric with a target value or improvement and a budget, adjustable while the work runs. ESOI Application records that metric as a spec and applies the principles, creating and editing specs and metrics. Goal Completion says whether the goal's condition was met against its done-standard. Response Quality judges the response against the quality profile resolved for the request.
